messages.text:
Sorry about my bad drawing, I have been pressing the buttons not the PCB. I will try again later but I have been doing what you suggest below so I don't expect different results.

Andrew T.
Handed to the team · Flashing fault beyond what I can diagnose remotely; buttons, cable, port and seq

Hi Andrew,

No apology needed, the drawing told me what I needed either way, and if you have been on the right pair of buttons all along then we have genuinely ruled the sequence out. So I agree with you, there is no point grinding through it a fifth time and getting the same error.

That leaves the module itself, and in particular that green Power Board Error flashing past on every boot. That is not something I want to keep guessing at from here, so I have put it in front of JD, who writes and maintains the Harlo OS side. He has your error text, the button sequences you tried and the photo.

The fastest route to him is our Discord, where he is active most days. You can post in the server and mention @nullhashrate, who shows as JD with the Admin role, and he can usually look at something like this the same day: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

If you would rather not use Discord, that is fine, he will come back to you on this thread instead. The team picks this up today at 10am ET and the reply comes to your email.

One thing worth saying plainly: your BC04 is mining happily on Thor OS right now, so nothing is at risk while we sort this out. Harlo OS is an upgrade, not a requirement.

Thanks for the patience on this one, Andrew.

I await JD wisdom on this issue. I am running now on Thor OS and I did manage to update it. I am not sure what that tells you.

Andrew T.

Hi Andrew,

It tells me more than you might think, and it is good news on the hardware.

An over the air update means the module downloaded a firmware image, wrote it to its own flash, verified it and rebooted on it. That exercises the flash chip, the memory and the whole write path, and all of it passed. So the module is not faulty in the way I was starting to suspect, and it is not at risk of being bricked by any of this.

What it narrows things down to is the USB side specifically. Everything over the air works, everything over the serial port does not get as far as download mode. That is a much smaller problem than a bad board, and it is exactly the sort of detail that saves JD an hour, so I have added it to what he already has.

One thing worth saying while you wait. Do not go hunting for another way to force it in the meantime. You have a miner that is up, mining and now on current firmware, and nothing you are missing is urgent. Harlo OS is a different dashboard and feature set, not a fix for anything that is wrong.

If you would rather not wait, JD is on our Discord most days and you can put the question straight to him there, posting in the server and mentioning @nullhashrate: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Otherwise he will come back to you here. The team picks this up today from 10am ET and his reply comes to your email.

Thanks for the update, Andrew, that was a genuinely useful piece of information.

Just worked the time difference JD is in 3pm my time, I am on British summer time until the 25th.

Andrew T.

Hi Andrew,

That is right. We open at 10am Eastern, which is 3pm for you while British Summer Time is still running, and the gap goes to four hours once the clocks change at the end of the month.

Nothing is needed from you before then. JD has the error text, both button sequences, the photo of the module and the fact that the over the air update went through cleanly, so he can pick it up with the full picture rather than asking you to repeat anything.

If you happen to be at the PC this afternoon and want a faster answer, he is usually about on our Discord and you can put it to him directly there, posting in the server and mentioning @nullhashrate: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf

Otherwise just sit tight, leave the BC04 mining as it is, and his reply comes to you here.

Thanks for your patience with this one, Andrew.

Do you have the exact part number and description so I can look into getting one?

Andrew T.
Handed to the team · Need the exact LilyGo model/part number from JD before the customer buys the wro

Hi Andrew,

Fair question, and I am not going to guess at it. There are several LilyGo boards that look near enough identical in a photo and differ in the chip, the screen and the pin header, and the wrong one would cost you money and still not flash.

So I have gone back to JD for the exact model and description of the board he means, since he is the one who knows which variant Harlo OS expects on a BC04. I have also asked him whether this is something we should be supplying you rather than you sourcing it yourself, given the unit came from us. I have only asked, I am not promising an outcome, but I did not want to send you shopping without putting that question first.

He is on this afternoon, so you should have the part number from him shortly, either here or from me once he comes back with it.

In the meantime your BC04 carries on mining happily on Thor OS, so nothing is lost while we sort the board out.

Thanks for sticking with it, Andrew.
